hypothesis: Can an exactly complete physically paid 216-triple action-history cover, compared with individually paid feedback-active and hash-random controls, resolve WSP85's heldout causal-operator ambiguity on physically reachable >=2-action histories? Determine separately whether residual abstentions are confined to unrepeatable cold-start histories.

worlds.source: Implement WSP85 causal mechanism unchanged (visible six-bit state; base action toggle and optional hidden three masked action-history majority with secret target), but use independently SHA256-derived WSP86|DEV|seed|slot/domain-v1 private parameters and new unregistered seeds. Source can only be imported by evaluator/harness, not by weight editor, selector, symbolic solver or neural baseline.
worlds.stageA: All three arms independently pay identical 144 SHA256 WSP86|DEV|seed|stageA|step-v1 actions; identical public StageA trajectories and hashes required.

stageB.debruijn_full_triple: Source-blind deterministic 6-ary order-3 de Bruijn cycle via canonical lexicographically minimal construction; select lexicographically earliest cycle rotation matching the two already-paid StageA tail actions as its first two symbols, then take its subsequent 240 symbols cyclically, paying for each consequence. This must yield all 216 distinct ordered 3-action histories at least once within StageB alone.
stageB.WSP85_hypothesis_active: Unmodified WSP85 HypothesisInterventionPolicy code, refit schedule, action-ranking constants and 512-hypothesis cap; train only on this arm's independently paid public ledger.
stageB.hash_random: SHA256('WSP86|DEV|seed|random|step-v1') first8 bytes modulo6, independent of source; pay independently.

worlds.evaluator_query_contexts: Exactly WSP85 43 contexts: empty(), each of 6 single actions, and each of 36 action pairs. Every context x 64 visible states x 6 actions = 16512 queries per arm/world.
worlds.source_private_labels: Only after all numerical, symbolic and neural outputs across 18 sessions are SHA256 sealed; never pass private masks/target to any learning or action policy.
worlds.first_use: Unregistered WSP86 DEV only. Never instantiate/read protected WSP80 registered 5601..5616, prior WSP85 10201..10206, or any other sealed scientific cohorts.

controls.primary: Exactly unchanged source-blind WSP84 PaidOperatorInducer for every arm, cold-restore numerical weight inference and abstention.
controls.matched_symbolic: Exactly unchanged independent WSP84 symbolic truth-table solver, with parity across all 18 sessions required.
controls.neural: Unmodified WSP84 fully trained 25->64 ReLU->6 3-restart history-aware Adam 6000-step ceiling for all 18 sessions; report nonconvergence, never conceal it. All charge from identical arm-specific public observations, same action/time budget.
controls.additional: Original WSP83 XOR2, memoryless and paid-pair-lookup negative controls; identical paid ledgers per corresponding arm.

labels.DEV_COVERAGE_CAUSAL_GAIN: Only if all required criteria pass and debruijn yields >=96 novel-world reachable-history correct additional predictions compared to EACH matched paid control; symbolic parity means no neural-intelligence advantage.
labels.DEV_REACHABILITY_BOUND_DIAGNOSIS: If all debruijn worlds cover 216 triples and length2 abstentions vanish but cold-start abstentions remain, report that within-grammar, within-run evidence suggests cold-start unidentifiability; not a causality or universal bound proof.
labels.DEV_COVERAGE_NEGATIVE: If required gain, safe accuracy, source parity, coverage, or training criteria fail, preserve the negative. No threshold/seed/algorithm retuning after first world outcomes.
labels.UNVERIFIED: If pristine source identity, first-use, CI or outputs are missing, no experiment result or scientific claim.

interpretation: Limited six-bit familiar synthetic causal grammar. At most identifies whether intervention-history coverage or information at unrepeatable cold start constrains the existing rule class. Not independent discovery of unfamiliar operators, lifelong learning, open-world transfer, language intelligence or AGI. Compare with same-expressivity symbolic and fully trained neural, no unsupported compute speedups.
